messages:
Maya (AE): Sentinal Health wants a 4-week POC: private VPC deployment, HSM-backed KMS, model pinning to a 13B family, steady 5k embeddings/min with 30k spikes, and 99th percentile latency SLA. Attached their RFI + security questionnaire. Who can own technical answers?
Ethan (SE): I can own the technical onramps. Quick clarification: embeddings qps depends on model and quant. Is embeddings path GPU or CPU? Also need sample payloads and seq len.
Maya (AE): Customer replied: avg 512 tokens for text-gen, embeddings are 768-d vectors. Sample payloads uploaded to sales drive (sentinel_payloads.zip).
Liam (Solutions Eng): Proposal idea: Dedicated VPC with reserved capacity, HSM via KMS-proxy, plus a hosted burst endpoint as fallback. Recommend quantized 13B for embeddings to hit qps. Also enable prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts.
Priya (Security): Upload security questionnaire PDF and network diagram to tracker. I need to map items to SOC2 controls and KMS attestation. Do we have a documented BYO-HSM attestation process?
Casey (CS): I will prepare the onboarding runbook and POC playbook. Can coordinate test dataset and acceptance criteria.
Maya (AE): Uploaded: sentinel_rfi_q1.pdf, sentinel_sample_payloads.zip, and network diagram link https://drive.redwood/sentinel/netdiag.png
Ethan (SE): To validate perf, ask them to run a 1-hour tail latency trace or share traces. Also share this synthetic perf script for baseline testing:
Ethan (SE): ```bash
for i in {1..5000}; do curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-quant","input":"short text","max_tokens":512}' & done
```
Liam (Solutions Eng): For cost estimate: suggest reserved 2x A100 per shard + a burst pool. I'll draft capacity numbers and cost ranges.
Priya (Security): Immediate security asks: KMS/HSM model and attestation, key rotation cadence, data residency and how KV/cache persists, encryption-at-rest details, audit log retention and RBAC, private peering support and IP allowlists. Mark which require engineering signoff.
Maya (AE): Legal also asked for subprocessor list and SOC2 report. I'll pull legal in to provide those docs.
Casey (CS): I'll gather subproc list and a sanitized SOC2 sample. Also creating POC timeline and will invite stakeholders for kickoff next Wed 10am PT.
Ethan (SE): I'll begin drafting RFI technical answers for latency, throughput, model pinning, and fallback policies. Priya, tagging you for security responses.
Priya (Security): Adding their questionnaire to our tracker now, will flag any redlines by EOD tomorrow. Also starting a FedRAMP mapping where applicable.
Maya (AE): Action items: Ethan = RFI technical answers + perf script, Liam = capacity/cost proposal + caching plan, Priya = security questionnaire mapping, Casey = onboarding runbook + SOC2/subproc, Maya = schedule kickoff and request NDA addendum.
redwood-bot: Reminder set for kickoff: 2024-06-12 10:00 PT.
Ethan (SE): Note: if they insist on customer-managed HSM connector we need infra signoff. I'll ping runtime infra.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Will request infra review.
Casey (CS): Calendar invites sent.
Priya (Security): Will surface any blocker items after mapping. :white_check_mark:
